headline: 美退還千億美元關稅
context: 美國政府已退還大約1,000億美元的「解放日」關稅收入，約佔先前徵收關稅總額的六成。此前，最高法院已裁定川普政府課徵的這批關稅違法，其餘款項預計陸續退還。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: More than half of tariff income refunded after supreme court ruled Trump’s levies were illegal Business live – latest updates The Trump administration has refunded about $100bn from the tariffs it collected before the US supreme court ruled them illegal, according to reports. The $100bn (£74bn) figure, which represents 60% of the total $165bn collected from Donald Trump’s “liberation day” tariffs, was reported by customs officials to the US court of international trade (CIT) on Tuesday, according to the Financial Times. Continue reading...
sources.title: US refunds $100bn of Donald Trump’s ‘liberation day’ tariffs

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: It represents roughly 60% of all tariff revenue collected under the policy, with billions still to be repaid.
sources.title: Trump administration pays back $100bn in 'Liberation Day' tariffs to businesses

thread_text:
美國政府已退還大約1,000億美元的「解放日」關稅收入，約佔先前徵收關稅總額的六成。此前，最高法院已裁定川普政府課徵的這批關稅違法，其餘款項預計陸續退還。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 BBC 的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
美國政府已退還大約1,000億美元的「解放日」關稅收入，約佔先前徵收關稅總額的六成。此前，最高法院已裁定川普政府課徵的這批關稅違法，其餘款項預計會陸續退還給企業。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 BBC 於 2026 年 8 月 6 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 美國政府，已經退還大約1,000億美元的「解放日」關稅收入——大概是新台幣3.1兆——約佔先前徵收關稅總額的六成。最高法院先前已經裁定，川普政府課徵的這批關稅違法，剩下的款項，預計會陸續退還。
